xna-type.name: EffectProcessorDebugMode
xna-type.summary: This enumeration is available only when developing for Windows.

member.name: Auto
member.summary: Enables effect debugging when built with Debug profile.

member.name: Debug
member.summary: Enables effect debugging for all profiles. Will produce unoptimized shaders.

member.name: Optimize
member.summary: Disables debugging for all profiles, produce optimized shaders.
